Reviewed exact signed generation verification, private deployment state, finite generation budget, high-water sequence, create-new lock and pending records. Reviewed declarative systemd/launchd configuration, argument escaping without shells, user/runtime manager calls and bounded loopback diagnostic challenge. Reviewed opt-in fixture arguments, loopback-only challenge listener and Windows SCM status/stop handling. It has no product credentials or Core/Gate integration and is excluded from default targets; public docs describe its readiness as diagnostic only.

Reviewed all process cases and fixture cleanup.
